description: A peerless adventurer whose one hundred travelogues document his journeys; apprehended at Balduq as a suspect in the Romun Fleet’s Atlas Ocean disappearance, he becomes involved with the city’s Monstrums.

power_traditions.note: Product page says Aprilis turns him into a Monstrum with supernatural Gifts.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: Prison City site of selected adventure.

canon_status: Named primary-card figure in the selected official Ys IX page.

supports: Name, travelogues, fleet case, Balduq detention, and Monstrum involvement
Aprilis transformation, Monstrum Gifts, fellow-Monstrums alliance, curse and Grimwald premise

comparison_cautions: The one-hundred-travelogue statement is not used to merge Ys continuities or establish events of other titles.

description: A Monstrum who styles herself a chivalrous thief, stealing from the wealthy and giving to Balduq’s shantytown; her agile physique supports speedy attacks.

power_traditions.note: She is directly called a Monstrum; individual Gift name not inferred from this card.

canon_status: Named primary-card Monstrum codename; real identity unstated.

supports: Codename, Monstrum status, thief role, Balduq activity, and agility

comparison_cautions: The codename is retained; no real identity is inferred.

description: A Monstrum known in Balduq as the Feral Hawk, who tests his skills by assaulting others in the name of divine retribution and is described as the least cooperative Monstrum.

power_traditions.note: Direct Monstrum status; no individual Gift is attributed from this card.

canon_status: Named primary-card Monstrum codename; real identity unstated.

supports: Codename/Feral Hawk, Monstrum status, conduct, and noncooperation

comparison_cautions: Card characterizations do not establish a full criminal record or real identity.

description: A Monstrum resembling an antique doll who can perceive what normal humans cannot; her origins remain a mystery even to fellow Monstrums.
canon_status: Named primary-card Monstrum codename; real identity/origin unstated.

supports: Codename, Monstrum status, doll-like appearance, perception ability, and origin mystery

comparison_cautions: Her declared mystery is preserved; no artificial origin or identity is inferred.
